title: finance.cash.moved, schema_version 1
description: Cash went into or out of a cash drawer (a till) to or from somewhere other than the business's cash: banked (Dr bank / Cr cash), taken from the bank (Dr cash / Cr bank), or paid out for an expense (Dr the expense / Cr cash). Moves between a drawer and the safe stay within cash and are not sent. Amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit.

reference.description: The product's own reference for the movement (a till number and the movement's place in it).

direction.description: Into the drawer, or out of it.

counterpart.description: Where the cash came from or went: the bank, or an expense (out only).

expense_account.description: The expense account's code; Other expenses when null or not an active expense account.
